_doc: Burned-in Japanese text in the QuickTime movies, replaced at playback by pre-rendered English subtitles (tools/make_subs.py -> data_en/dc/mov/<movie>.sub). 'win' is the search window in seconds; the exact fade-in/out and the area to cover are measured from the video.

phantom.en:
Thanks to the young heroes,
the school turned castle of ice was restored.
The curse of the mask was lifted,
and one of the school's legends came to an end.

As long as there are hearts
that turn hope into despair,
the eternal night will come again and again.

Leaving the queen's words behind them,
the boys and girls who cast off
the darkness in their hearts
begin to walk toward the future...

remix4.en: Once, I dreamed I was a butterfly.

I was so wholly a butterfly that I did not know
it was my own dream. But when I suddenly woke,
there I was, unmistakably myself,
and not a butterfly at all.

Was I dreaming that I was a butterfly?
Or is a butterfly dreaming that it is me?

Surely, though there is a distinction between
the butterfly and me, it is no absolute difference,
and no cause and effect holds between us.
~ Zhuangzi ~

Time flows on, and people seem to bury
everything deep in their memories.
In a world where nothing stands still,
as if driven by something,
as if fleeing the contradictions within,
the tide of people flows away somewhere...
Today, once again.
